status: Provisional transparent policy to implement, challenge and revise from tests; not calibrated scientific confidence.
unknowns: Use zero earned credit for unknown applicable indicators and display coverage/missing fields. With no usable evidence, score is null and state is unassessed. Do not reweight around unknowns.
normalization: Pure named reducers and type-specific documented indicators; no executable configuration or model-supplied final score.

adoption.count_normalization: Fixed usage bands: attention/single-user .25, multiple-users .5, sustained .75, broad 1. Above .25 requires two independent non-primary origins; above .75 requires three. Counts alone do not establish use.

relevance.ordering: Direct before related before unknown before out-of-scope; within bucket use Signal score, evidence coverage, stable ID. Other sorts are explicit.

automatic_save_requires: resolved identity and minimally supported defining claim
score at or above configured threshold
no unresolved blocking contradiction for the defining claim
public-safe serialized record for Git-visible corpus
automatic_save_does_not_require: a second model call for every candidate
a local installation or execution trial
permission to redistribute an entire linked project when only permitted facts and citations are retained
invariants: same inputs + policy + effective time yield same score
exact duplicates and mirrored mentions do not increase score
more valid independent support cannot reduce the corroboration component at fixed other inputs and time
critical contrary evidence can lower overall score or prevent autosave
unchanged source re-fetch does not create new corroboration
user preference changes relevance/selection, not external evidence
Context repeating Signals output is not independent corroboration
